title: Product Editing & Image Stabilization
changes: Keep /admin/products/ compact at eight rows by default with explicit paging.
Route Product thumbnails through the canonical same-origin /api/product-media R2 reader.
Retain /media/product as a zero-D1 compatibility alias for older image tools.
Add /api/product-detail-core as a bounded public Product record/gallery endpoint without schema introspection or catalog scans.
Replace the public Product detail renderer with an 8-second fail-fast bounded renderer to prevent indefinite Loading product states.
Make historical Product browser and route proofs successor-aware so they no longer execute retired high-read paths against Build 166.
next_direction: Finish Product image recovery visibility and guided first-image repair.
Consolidate Product Editor and Product Media Editor around one bounded Product context.
Add operator-controlled image reference audit that reports stale versus resolvable R2 keys without catalog-wide automatic scans.
Continue the existing roadmap after Product editing and image stability are proven GREEN.
